prompt: Use xpedition-pcb to check the board in the running Layout session.
expected: Read ../xpedition-cli/SKILL.md and run its first step before pcb check --project X.prj.

prompt: The schematic of the demo sensor board is drawn and packaged. Turn it into a board.
expected: pcb create dry run and confirm, session start --kind pcb, pcb annotate dry run and confirm; done only on outcome annotated with matching counts; pcb info to read the board back.

prompt: Place the parts on the new board, route it and tell me whether it is clean.
expected: Outline, holes, rules, then pcb arrange dry run (grow the outline while summary.outside is not empty), labels (move parts apart for any unplaced designator), inner pour, pcb route, outer pours after routing, pcb check; checked only when it passes, board_rules has no high or medium finding and every warning kind is explained.

prompt: Send this board out for fabrication.
expected: Read reference/fabrication.md; pcb check first (it passes, no high or medium board rule, every warning explained), then pcb export --output DIR --dry-run and confirm; ready only when checks.ok is true; say what the README leaves to the board house.

prompt: I changed the footprint of U3 in the library. Update the board.
expected: Annotating keeps the old cell; project backup, then pcb create --replace (STOP CHECKPOINT, --dangerous after the user agrees, report the archive), annotate and lay out again.

prompt: Two parts are still unplaced on the routed board. Run the arrange so they get placed.
expected: A confirmed arrange deletes all routing first; prefer pcb move for the two parts; if the arrange is still wanted, project backup and stop for the user's agreement before --dangerous.

prompt: Move R12 two millimetres to the left, nothing else.
expected: Read R12's position (pcb geometry --refdes R12), pcb move --refdes R12 --to <x-2,y> dry run and confirm, then pcb check for the routing around it; routing again only if the user asks.

prompt: I annotated the board but Layout shows nothing on it. Is it broken?
expected: Not broken: annotated parts are unplaced until placed, and the stock display scheme hides top-side parts; pcb info counts them, pcb show changes the scheme.

prompt: Route only VBAT and +3V3 for now; I will do the signals by hand.
expected: pcb route --nets VBAT,+3V3 dry run and confirm; the other nets stay unrouted; hand routing per reference/hand-routing.md.

prompt: Move C12 next to U3's supply pin and tell me whether the layout got better.
expected: pcb metrics --output before.json first, the move, then pcb metrics --baseline before.json; answer from the deltas (decoupling distance, ratsnest, crossings, overlaps).

prompt: How thick is this board and what trace width does the POWER class use?
expected: pcb info: thickness_mm, the stackup, and net_classes with their widths per layer.

prompt: The decoupling capacitor C201 is 9 mm from U201's supply pin on the finished board. Fix it.
expected: pcb metrics --output before.json; pcb unroute --nets for C201's nets (dangerous: ask), pcb pour --remove on the outer layers, pcb move C201 beside U201's supply pin, pcb route --nets, pour the outer layers again, pcb check, pcb metrics --baseline before.json quoting the decoupling delta.

prompt: Draw a schematic for a 5 V to 3.3 V regulator with an I2C sensor.
Check the board in the running Layout session. (The entry Skill is not installed here: ../xpedition-cli/SKILL.md is missing.)
expected: STOP CHECKPOINT: tell the user the entry Skill is missing and, once they agree, install the family with npx skills add fatecannotbealtered/xpedition-cli -y -g.
